summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Mark Day, born September 21, 1961 in Clarksville, Tennessee, who is described as a former NASCAR driver who raced for several years in NASCAR's higher division. It also notes that his family owns the #05 31-W Racing Chevy, which competes part-time in the Busch Series and full-time in the ARCA RE/MAX Series.
one_line: Mark Day is a former NASCAR driver whose family owns the #05 31-W Racing team in the Busch and ARCA series.
key_facts: Mark Day was born September 21, 1961 in Clarksville, Tennessee.
Mark Day is a former NASCAR driver.
Mark Day raced for a number of years in NASCAR's higher division.
Mark Day's family currently owns the #05 31-W Racing Chevy in the Busch Series.
The #05 31-W Racing Chevy races in the Busch Series on a part-time basis.
The #05 31-W Racing Chevy races full-time in the ARCA RE/MAX Series.
